title: Faceted Filter Evaluation & Invariant Truth Table
description: Formal boolean truth table verifying exhaustive, non-contradictory resolutions for facet combinations and query inputs.

propositions.name: Query String Present
propositions.description: User has typed at least 1 non-whitespace character in the search input.

propositions.name: Item Type Filter Active
propositions.description: User has selected at least 1 item type (product, scam, airport, etc.).

propositions.name: Pillar Filter Active
propositions.description: User has selected at least 1 sovereign security pillar.

propositions.name: Personalization Active
propositions.description: User has toggled zero-PII personal trip tailoring.

propositions.name: Matches Found (>0)
propositions.description: Filtered candidate pool contains 1 or more matching documents.

outputVariables.description: Alert level: green, yellow, amber, orange, crimson.

outputs.script: No exact matches found. Suggested relaxation: widen price tier or clear query terms.
outputs.posture: Display empty-state banner with one-click filter reset and related category links.

rows.formalRationale: Empty pool with active query requires graceful relaxation guidance without blocking user flow.

outputs.script: Selected type and pillar combination has zero items in current catalog.
outputs.posture: Highlight conflicting facet badge in rose and prompt traveler to toggle alternate type.

rows.formalRationale: Disjunctive cross-facet AND logic yielded an empty intersection; prompt facet loosening.

outputs.script: Showing security tools tailored for your destination and active threat profile.
outputs.posture: Render items with destination badges and elevated SPOF mitigation indicators.

rows.formalRationale: Golden state for contextual discovery: local-first trip context intersects successfully with search query.

outputs.posture: Render standard grid with active facet counters and sorting controls.

outputs.script: Full security catalog and tactical LEGO blocks.
outputs.posture: Render default priority list showing curated top-tier items across all 7 pillars.

rows.formalRationale: Clean entry state: full directory displayed ordered by default relevance.

title: Cloudflare Edge Worker vs Local Browser Execution Truth Table
description: Verifies deterministic routing of faceted search queries between Cloudflare Edge Workers and in-browser local WASM/JS execution.

propositions.name: Personalized Only Mode
propositions.description: Query utilizes Zero-PII browser localStorage persona data.

propositions.name: Edge Cache Warm
propositions.description: Cloudflare Edge Key-Value / Cache API holds precomputed response.

propositions.name: Standard SKAG Path
propositions.description: Request targets static canonical facet route (e.g. /playbook/solo-female/rome/).

outputs.script: Offline mode active. Running faceted search against indexed local-first cache.
outputs.posture: Zero network calls; 100% in-browser client memory execution.

rows.formalRationale: Solo travelers in transit or without cellular service must retain full offline search functionality.

outputs.script: Zero-PII Privacy Shield active. Trip context evaluated locally in browser.
outputs.posture: No personal trip parameters sent over wire; browser evaluates SEARCH_INDEX.

rows.formalRationale: Strict privacy requirement: traveler destination, flight hour, and persona never leak to edge logs.

outputs.script: Serving warm Cloudflare Edge Cache for canonical SKAG facet page.
outputs.posture: OpenNext Cloudflare Workers CDN cache hit (sub-15ms TTFB worldwide).

rows.formalRationale: Public canonical facet pages leverage worldwide Cloudflare PoPs for zero-compute delivery.

outputs.script: Evaluating dynamic GraphQL query via Cloudflare Worker GraphQL resolver.
outputs.posture: Worker evaluates faceted inverted index and populates edge cache.

rows.formalRationale: Standard dynamic query fallback with cold cache population.
